rationale: The agent verified the user correctly by matching full name and old ZIP to a single account, then used read-only tools to view the account without disclosing sensitive details the user wished to keep private. The agent did not perform any write action (address update) without the required new address details or explicit confirmation, which aligns with policy. For the t-shirt request, the agent correctly identified the cheapest available variant ($46.66, red L cotton v-neck) based on tool data and did not fabricate information. When asked to place a new order, the agent appropriately declined since placing new orders isn’t supported by the tools/policy and redirected to the website/app. Overall, actions and information were policy-compliant and accurate. A minor wording ambiguity suggested the user could provide partial address details, but no unsupported action was taken, so this does not rise to a failure.
